'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Middle Eastern crisis (2023–present)|Middle Eastern crisis]]
**[[2026 Iran war]]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Bahrain]]
****An [[Iran]]ian [[Unmanned aerial vehicles in the Iranian military|drone]] hits and damages a [[desalination]] plant in [[Bahrain]]. In addition, falling missile debris injures three people and damages a university building in [[Manama]]. [https://english.aawsat.com/gulf/5248760-drone-damages-desalination-plant-bahrain (''Asharq Al-Awsat'')]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Bahrain)|Bahraini health ministry]] reports that an Iranian drone strike on the island of [[Sitra]] injured 32 civilians, including four with serious injuries. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/iran-drone-attack-on-bahrain-leaves-32-civilians-wounded-health-ministry/ (AFP via ''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Kuwait]]
****The main building of the [[Public Institution for Social Security Fund|Public Institution for Social Security]] in [[Kuwait City]] suffers an [[airstrike]]. A large fire breaks out, but no injuries are reported.  [https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/pifss-main-building-in-kuwait-damaged-in-attack-no-injuries-reported/ (Arab Times)]
***[[2026 Iranian strikes on Saudi Arabia]]
**** The [[United States Central Command]] confirms that a [[United States Armed Forces|U.S. service member]] has died of wounds sustained after an Iranian attack on a base in [[Saudi Arabia]] on March 1, bringing the confirmed death toll among U.S. forces to seven since the start of the conflict. [https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/08/politics/us-service-member-killed-iran-war (CNN)]
***Joint airstrikes by [[Israel]] and the [[United States]] are carried out against [[Oil tanker|oil facilities]] in [[Tehran]] and other Iranian cities, killing at least four truck drivers and causing large fires. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/8/israel-strikes-irans-oil-facilities-for-first-time-as-war-enters-ninth-day (Al Jazeera)]
***According to Israeli sources, [[United Arab Emirates]] (UAE) warplanes carried out airstrikes against Iran, and purportedly struck a desalination plant. However, UAE officials denied any involvement in the alleged attacks. [https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/live-blog-update/uae-government-figure-denies-israeli-reports-strike-iran (Middle East Eye)]
**[[Hezbollah–Israel conflict (2023–present)|Hezbollah–Israel conflict]]

****Four people are killed and 10 more injured in an [[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[airstrike]] on a [[Ramada]] hotel in central [[Beirut]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20260308-nowhere-safe-after-israeli-strike-on-central-beirut-hotel (AFP via France 24)]
****Two [[Israeli Defense Forces|Israeli soldiers]] are killed in overnight clashes with [[Hezbollah]] in [[southern Lebanon]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/3/8/iran-live-israel-bombs-tehran-oil-depots-attacks-on-gulf-states-continue?update=4377953 (Al Jazeera)]

[https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israeli-strike-kills-two-palestinians-car-gaza-medics-say-2026-03-08/ (Reuters)]

Another Palestinian is killed after Israeli soldiers throw [[smoke grenade]]s during the attack. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/3/8/israeli-settlers-kill-two-palestinians-in-occupied-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and 60 others are injured when a bus carrying [[Zimbabwe|Zimbabwean]] nationals collides with a car on [[N6 (South Africa)|N6]] near [[Stutterheim]], [[Eastern Cape]], [[South Africa]]. [https://www.citizen.co.za/news/five-killed-60-foreign-nationals-injured-eastern-cape-head-on-crash/ (''The Citizen'')]
*At least four people are killed and several others are trapped after a section of the [[Bantar Gebang]] [[landfill]] in [[Bekasi]], [[West Java]], [[Indonesia]], [[Garbage landslide|collapses]] amid heavy rainfall. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-searches-missing-after-landfill-collapse-kills-four-2026-03-09/ (Reuters)]
*Two people are killed and 19 people are injured following a mining incident in [[Samarkandek]], [[Batken Region]], [[Kyrgyzstan]]. [https://gazeta.kg/en/incidents/177722-chp-na-shahte-batken-munaj-dvoe-pogibli-postradali-19-chelovek.html (Gazeta)]
*[[2026 Glasgow fire|A fire]] occurs in a historic building adjoining the [[Glasgow Central railway station]] in [[Scotland]], [[United Kingdom]]. The building collapses, destroying a number of businesses and shops. The fire also causes the disruption and cancellation of many [[Transport in Scotland#Railways|train services]], with Glasgow Central promptly shutting down until further notice. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/cde4p01g0r1t (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2026 Colombian parliamentary election]]
**[[Colombians]] vote to elect 183 members of the [[Chamber of Representatives of Colombia|Chamber of Representatives]] and 103 members of the [[Senate of Colombia|Senate]]. [https://apnews.com/article/colombia-election-congress-presidential-candidates-petro-4766c3c2098610f24ec91aa61d793a4e (AP)]
*[[2026 Iranian Supreme Leader election]]
**[[Mojtaba Khamenei]], the son of [[Assassination of Ali Khamenei|the late]] [[Ali Khamenei]], is elected as the next [[Supreme Leader of Iran|Supreme Leader]] of [[Iran]]. [https://apnews.com/article/iran-israel-us-march-8-2026-f0b20dbffaea9351ae1e54183ffe53ff (AP)]
*[[2026 Nepalese general election]]
**The [[Rastriya Swatantra Party]] wins 124 direct seats and leads in one more from 164 of 165 constituencies reported so far in [[Nepal]]. The results from the [[Dhanusha 1 (constituency)|Dhanusha 1 constituency]] are withheld pending an order from the [[Supreme Court of Nepal|Supreme Court]]. [https://thehimalayantimes.com/nepal/rsp-wins-119-direct-seats-as-landslide-nears-its-final-shape (''The Himalayan Times'')]
*[[2026 Swiss referendums]]
**[[Swiss people|Swiss]] voters reject a referendum proposing to reduce the [[Swiss Broadcasting Corporation]]'s annual [[Broadcast license|licence]] fee. They also reject a proposal for a climate fund and support efforts to maintain the status of [[cash]] and remove individual taxation for married couples. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/swiss-politics/march-8-2026-vote-the-results-from-across-switzerland/90932419/ (Swissinfo.ch)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2026 Men's T20 World Cup]]
**[[India national cricket team| India]] wins the 2026 [[Men's T20 World Cup]], beating [[New Zealand national cricket team| New Zealand]] by 96 runs in the final. They become the first team to win back-to-back T20 World Cups, the first team to win the title at home as hosts, and the first team to win the tournament three times. [https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/2026-mens-t20-world-cup-likely-from-february-7-to-march-8-1502118 (ESPNcricinfo)]
*[[2026 AFC Women's Asian Cup]], [[2026 Iranian diaspora protests]]
**Diaspora protesters surround the bus of the [[Iran women's national football team|Iranian women's soccer team]] following their match against the [[Philippines women's national soccer team|Philippines]] in [[Gold Coast, Queensland|Gold Coast]], [[Queensland]], [[Australia]], amidst fears of their safety upon returning to Iran after members of the team gave [[SOS]] hand signals from the team bus. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2026-03-09/asian-cup-2026-protesters-surround-iran-team-bus/106431212 (ABC News Australia)] [https://www.dw.com/en/fears-grow-for-irans-womens-football-team/a-76278906 (DW)]
*Nathan Martin wins the 2026 [[Los Angeles Marathon]] in the marathon's closest-ever finish, becoming the second consecutive American to win the event. [https://www.latimes.com/sports/story/2026-03-08/nathan-martin-wins-closest-la-marathon-in-race-history (''Los Angeles Times'')]
